goal: Build an e-commerce storefront with cart

research.recommended_stack: Responsive Storefront HTML5/CSS3 + Interactive Cart State Engine (JS) + Python Order API
alternatives_compared: Lightweight Local Storefront + Python JSON/SQLite API
research.why_selected: Fast local execution with built-in cart calculations and zero paid dependencies.

layout_rules: Responsive CSS Grid with auto-fit cards (mobile 360px to 4K desktop)
High-contrast WCAG AA compliant text on dark glassmorphic panels
GPU-friendly CSS transform/opacity transitions (<2% CPU usage)
